title: Inner verifier address map
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$, let $V$ be its quadratic variable count and let $M=2^V+2^{V^2}$ be the number of inner-proof positions. The map from the disjoint union of the $V$ extension positions and the $M$ inner-proof positions to the disjoint union of the $n$ circuit inputs and the $V+M$ proof positions sends each extension position $i$ to proof position $i$ and each inner-proof position $j$ to proof position $V+j$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
An address in the disjoint union of the quadratic variable positions and inner-proof positions
